text.title: event-sourcing-basics Examples
text.summary: Base Event dataclass and domain event hierarchy for an Order aggregate. Order aggregate with _apply dispatch, create factory, from_events reconstruct, and pending events pattern. Good/bad contrasts for the two event antipatterns.

example.code:
from dataclasses import dataclass, field from datetime import datetime from uuid import UUID, uuid4
@dataclass(frozen=True) class Event: """Base class for all domain events.""" event_id: UUID = field(default_factory=uuid4) occurred_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow) metadata: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

example.note: All events inherit from Event (frozen) and carry only the data that changed. No full-state snapshots in events.
Command methods call _apply which both mutates state and queues events. Replay calls _apply with is_new=False.

example.code: event = OrderCreated(order_id=order_id) event.customer_id = new_customer_id # Modifying after creation — illegal
